levels.surface: أبو بردة بن أبي موسى الأشعري

notes: the report ends before its saying: the first branch stops at «مخرمة بن، بكير» before «ح»; the second, written in full, gives the names and ends at Ibn Umar, who speaks («قال لي»)
each branch repeats «ابن وهب» and «مخرمة», so the groups stay separate with a null tail; where the first branch's route ends is left to the archive
